name: reset_interrupt_and_dma_state
description: Writes the all-clear mask to the interrupt and DMA control registers, then sets selected enable bits and polls the interrupt request register in busy-wait loops. The decompiled tail is bad instruction data, so only the setup writes are reliable.

name: wait_vertical_beam_toggles
description: Busy-waits for the low bit of the vertical beam position register to change state the number of times held in the data register, counting screen lines by polling.

name: build_copper_list_six_planes
description: Writes a copper list for a six-bitplane display mode, with display window and data fetch values, bitplane pointer moves, display control values, colour entries and sprite pointer moves computed from the address passed in.

name: build_copper_list_one_plane
description: Writes a copper list for a one-bitplane display mode, setting the display window, data fetch, bitplane pointer, control and sprite pointer entries from the address passed in.

name: start_five_plane_copper_list
description: Writes a full copper list for a five-bitplane display into memory, then loads the copper location register and strobes the copper jump so the list takes effect.

name: step_colour_table_toward_target
description: Moves each 4-bit red, green and blue component of a colour table one unit toward the matching entry of a target table, or one unit down when the control flag is negative, and clears the control flag once every entry has settled.

name: step_colour_table_toward_target
description: Moves each 4-bit red, green and blue component of a colour table one unit toward the matching entry of a target table, or one unit down when the control flag is negative, and clears the control flag once every entry has settled.

name: fade_colour_table_no_return
description: Performs the same one-step colour table fade as its neighbouring routine but returns no value, and clears the control flag once every entry has settled.

name: depack_bitstream_backwards
description: Unpacks a compressed stream from its end by reading flag bits that choose between copying a run of earlier output bytes and writing literal bytes, using the bit-reader helpers and folding the packed data into a checksum.

name: configure_cia_and_dma_enables
description: Writes a short sequence of values to the CIA-A interrupt control register and the DMA control register, setting the DMA enable bit, and then writes a final value to a custom chip register.

name: split_offset_into_disk_track
description: Divides a position by 6144 to get a track number and an offset within that track, then sets disk controller state through the routines it calls.

name: select_drive_and_wait_ready
description: Sets the motor and drive select lines for the drive number given, then polls the drive ready status line for up to 16384 tries and returns with the result.

name: pulse_control_port_bits
description: Writes six byte values to a control port, each clearing a single bit in turn (bits six to three) and then restoring all bits, forming a fixed pulse sequence that takes no data input.

name: wait_status_bit_then_clear
description: Repeatedly calls a helper while bit four of a status byte is set, then clears a memory location once the bit is clear.

name: seek_disk_head_to_track
description: Compares the target track in the data register with the current track and steps the drive head one track at a time toward it, pulsing the step line and waiting between steps.

name: step_disk_head_by_count
description: Pulses the drive step line the number of times given in the data register, with a timed wait after each pulse so the head moves one track per pulse.

name: start_disk_track_dma_read
description: Programs the disk sync word, sets the disk DMA pointer and transfer length, then polls the disk block interrupt request before clearing the DMA length register.

name: xor_fold_checksum_longwords
description: XORs a run of longwords starting at the pointer together, then masks the result with a second register value and returns it.

name: merge_masked_longwords_shifted
description: Combines two longwords from adjacent memory positions with a mask: the masked second value is ORed with the masked first value shifted left by one bit, and the result is returned.

name: combine_masked_row_blocks
description: Combines data from two source positions into the destination using a mask and a one-bit shift, first handling a single word when the count requires it and then processing the remaining longwords.

name: verify_header_check_values
description: Checks that a byte read from memory equals a value derived from a control variable, and that two values returned by helpers match, before making one final helper call; otherwise it returns without action.

name: read_sectors_from_track_position
description: Rejects a zero count or a position beyond 1761 units, then divides the position by 11 to get the track and the sector within it, and transfers sectors through the routines it calls.

name: transfer_sectors_across_tracks
description: Repeatedly transfers sectors, subtracting each transferred sector from the remaining count, advancing the buffer pointer by 512 bytes per sector and moving to the next track when the sector index wraps.

name: forward_helper_result
description: Calls one helper routine and returns its result unchanged in the same register pair.

name: fill_buffer_with_gap_pattern
description: Fills a buffer of 416 longwords with a fixed alternating-bit pattern, unless its first longword already holds that pattern.

name: mark_track_entry_invalid
description: Makes up to eleven reads; when a value of at least eleven is read, it stores a full word of ones into the table entry for the current track and returns.

name: wait_for_marker_value
description: Repeats three helper calls a counted number of times, then reads values for up to eleven tries and returns once a read equals 28.

name: program_blitter_mask_passes
description: Programs the blitter for several passes: each pass sets its control registers, source, mask and destination pointers computed from the input offsets, and a size word, then starts the blit.

name: step_sector_index_modulo_eleven
description: Computes a starting sector index modulo 11 from its two inputs, then advances that index around the eleven-sector track for the count given, calling a helper on each step.

name: start_blitter_copy_pass
description: Computes three blitter pointer values from its input and an offset, programs the blitter control and size registers, and then calls a routine.

name: read_track_returning_status
description: Reads a sector through several helper calls, writes an alternating-bit pattern and a fill value into the buffer, and returns one of several status codes depending on the outcome.

name: return_status_code_21
description: Returns the fixed status value 21 with no other work.

name: return_status_code_26
description: Returns the fixed status value 26 with no other work.

name: return_status_code_22
description: Returns the fixed status value 22 with no other work.

name: return_status_code_24
description: Returns the fixed status value 24 with no other work.

name: return_status_code_23
description: Returns the fixed status value 23 with no other work.

name: return_status_code_25
description: Returns the fixed status value 25 with no other work.

name: set_top_bit_from_neighbour
description: Sets or clears the top bit of the byte at the pointer, choosing set or clear from the low bit of the preceding byte, and leaves the byte unchanged when bit six is already set in the set case.

name: store_byte_clearing_top_bit
description: Stores the low byte of the data register into the byte at the pointer with its top bit cleared.

name: verify_mfm_sector_checksum
description: Computes an XOR checksum over the longwords of a sector, masking each longword with an alternating-bit pattern, compares it with a second computed checksum and returns the status.

name: verify_sector_header_checksum
description: Reads two header longwords into the frame, computes an alternating-bit XOR over a block of longwords and compares it with a stored checksum, then returns 0 when the checksum and a sector value match, or 27 otherwise.

name: return_status_code_27
description: Returns the fixed status value 27 with no other work.

name: decode_mfm_long_pair
description: Extracts data bits from an odd and an even longword by masking each with an alternating-bit pattern, shifting the odd-position value left by one, and combining the two results.

name: xor_checksum_table
description: XORs together the longwords of a table, sized by the count in the data register, then masks the result with an alternating-bit pattern and returns it.

name: shift_bits_across_long_pair
description: Shifts a longword and the word after it by the same count and combines the shifted parts into one 32-bit result, realigning bitstream data.

name: call_three_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls three routines in order and returns with no result.

name: encode_mfm_clock_longword
description: Computes the clock bits for a longword from its data bits by inverting the masked odd bits and shifting them into clock positions, clears the top clock bit when a flag byte before the pointer is set, and stores the result combined with the data bits.

name: scan_marker_words_table_lookup
description: Scans words from the buffer for one of two marker words, then compares the word that follows with a table of values and returns the matching index, or minus one when the end of the buffer is reached.

name: scan_marker_words_lookup
description: Scans words from the buffer for one of two marker words, then compares the word that follows with a table of values and returns the matching index, or minus one at the end of the buffer.

name: scan_marker_words_swapped
description: Performs the same marker scan with the two marker words checked in the opposite order, returning the matching table index or minus one at the end of the buffer.

name: return_without_action
description: Does nothing and returns.

name: return_negative_one_status
description: Returns the value minus one as its status with no other work.

name: copy_word_or_start_blit
description: When the count is nonzero, copies a word from the buffer behind the pointer through a helper and stores it; otherwise it programs the blitter with a copy minterm, a shift value, the size and the pointers computed from its inputs, then starts the blit.

name: start_blitter_decode_pass
description: Programs the blitter control, size and pointer registers for a decode pass, using a shifted parameter and a computed size, then calls a routine.

name: wait_blitter_idle
description: Busy-waits while the blitter-busy bit is set in the hardware status register.

name: initialise_disk_controller_fields
description: Writes a DMA control word and an alternating fill pattern into a disk control block, sets a longword to all ones, and clears three state fields.

name: start_disk_dma_read
description: Under a condition from the caller, loads the disk buffer pointer, programs the disk control register for an MFM read, enables disk DMA and starts a read of a fixed length.

name: start_disk_transfer_if_flag
description: Checks bit three of the disk status port and, when it is set, programs the disk length and pointer registers and enables DMA, then calls a routine and returns its result; otherwise it returns the status 28.

name: wait_disk_block_interrupt
description: Polls the interrupt request register up to 400000 times for the disk block bit, then acknowledges that bit and stops disk DMA by clearing the length register, returning 0 on success or minus one on timeout.

name: acknowledge_disk_block_and_stop
description: Acknowledges the disk block interrupt request, stops disk DMA by writing the disk length register, and returns 0.

name: deselect_drive_bit
description: Clears one drive-select bit in the drive port register, with the bit chosen from a stored drive index, and keeps the other port bits unchanged.

name: wait_disk_ready_line_clear
description: Sets the control port to all ones, calls two helpers, then polls bit five of the disk status port for up to 15536 tries, returning 0 when that bit clears or 34 on timeout.

name: seek_drive_to_track
description: Compares the stored track position with the target track, steps the head once for each track of difference, records the new position and returns 0.

name: recalibrate_head_to_track_zero
description: Steps the head toward track zero up to 86 times, stopping when the track-zero sensor reports zero; it then sets the stored track position to zero and returns 0, or returns 30 when track zero is not reached.

name: reset_stored_track_position
description: Sets the stored track position for the drive to zero and returns 0.

name: set_step_direction
description: Sets or clears the step direction bit in the drive control port according to the sign of the direction value, forces the low bit set, and calls a routine to write the port.

name: write_port_then_delay
description: Writes the value returned by a helper to the drive control port, then busy-waits through a fixed delay of 15000 counts.

name: busy_wait_count_down
description: Busy-waits by counting the data register down to zero.

name: build_drive_select_bits
description: Builds a drive-select port value by clearing the bit chosen from the drive index, clears a second bit when the drive's stored flag is set, and returns the value.

name: store_zero_and_return
description: Stores zero to a memory word and returns, a short fragment that is only reached through a gap decode.

name: depack_bitstream_backwards_copy
description: Unpacks a compressed stream backwards in the same manner as the main depacker, reading flag bits to choose between back-reference copies and literal bytes.

name: read_literal_bits_backwards
description: Reads a group of bits from the bit buffer into the data register and writes the resulting byte backwards into the output, as one step of the depacker.

name: copy_back_reference_run
description: Copies a run of bytes from an earlier position in the output into the current output position, counting down the run length, as one step of the depacker.

name: copy_run_and_check_end
description: Finishes a back-reference copy by copying the remaining bytes of the run and returning once the output pointer reaches its end.

name: refill_bit_buffer_from_stream
description: Shifts the longword before the pointer right by one bit and sets its top bit, returning the refilled bit buffer value.

name: shift_bit_buffer_by_count
description: Shifts a bit buffer right by the number of times given in the count register, pulling in a longword from the stream with its top bit set each time the buffer empties.

name: stub_single_instruction_routine
description: Consists of a single instruction and has no decompiled body, so only its execution during the reference run is known.
